gates.label: Specification
gates.required_evidence: Package specification review against repository standards

gates.label: Scope and routing
gates.required_evidence: Positive/negative triggers and receiver-native handoff review

gates.label: Sources
gates.accountable_role: Data owner and applicable method/rule owner
gates.required_evidence: Actual source versions, applicability, licensing, access and source-to-field mapping

gates.label: Tools
gates.required_evidence: Actual tool contract, permissions, timeouts, identity and audit behavior

gates.label: Safety and compliance
gates.required_evidence: Applicable privacy, authorization, records and adverse-behavior review

gates.label: Quality
gates.required_evidence: Source-faithful practitioner output and arithmetic/method review

gates.label: Evaluations
gates.required_evidence: Representative holdout and adversarial model evaluation with limits/cost/latency

gates.label: Human acceptance
gates.accountable_role: Domain SME, control owner and applicable specialist approvers
gates.required_evidence: Named human reviews and actual reviewer authority for this scope

gates.label: Operations
gates.required_evidence: Pilot controls, monitoring, recovery, incident ownership and recertification

record_semantics: A complete supplied receipt is unverified evidence, never authenticated approval or deployment authority
portfolio_followups: External source workbook reconciliation is separate from catalog regeneration
Additional regional methods and comprehensive health-payer coverage remain separate scope decisions
